title: Black Panther and the hidden land.
lines: Deep in Africa there is a hidden land.
It's called Wakanda.
From the outside you only see mountains and forests.
But inside, Wakanda is full of wonders.
There are floating trains.
There are shining towers.
And there are clever machines.
Prince T'Challa lives in Wakanda.
He is the protector of his land.
When he puts on his black suit, he's Black Panther.
The suit is as black as the night.
It has sharp claws.
It's so strong that nothing can break it.
T'Challa has a clever sister.
Her name is Shuri.
Shuri is an inventor.
She makes the best machines in the world.
Look, brother, says Shuri.
I've made you new shoes.
You can walk very quietly in them.
Like a cat.
One day something terrible happens.
Someone has stolen a blue stone.
It's a magic stone from Wakanda.
Black Panther goes looking.
He creeps through the night.
His new shoes don't make a sound.
He jumps from roof to roof.
He's fast and nimble, just like a real panther.
Then he sees the thief.
The thief drives away in a fast car.
Shuri helps from her computer.
I'm driving a car for you, brother!
Jump on!
Black Panther jumps onto the car.
Shuri drives it from Wakanda, with her computer.
Vroom!
They catch up with the thief.
Black Panther jumps onto the thief's car.
The car stops with a jolt.
The thief tries to run away.
But Black Panther is faster.
He takes the blue stone back.
Why did you steal it?
asks Black Panther.
I wanted to be rich, says the thief.
Black Panther takes the thief to the police.
And he brings the stone back home.
In Wakanda they have a big party.
There's dancing and drumming.
T'Challa thinks.
Wakanda has so many wonderful things.
Maybe we should share them with the rest of the world.
And that's what he does.
He builds schools and hospitals for children everywhere.
Because a good king doesn't only take care of his own land.
He takes care of everyone.
Wakanda forever!
The end.
